resources.string: Lets ROUT perform the phone actions you ask for: tap a button you name, scroll, Back, Home and Recents. ROUT reads screen text on-device only to find what you named. It never reads or acts on password, OTP or payment screens. Off by default; enable only if you want screen control.
Command-only screen control: tap, scroll, Back, Home, Recents. No background capture.
